title: CHAP. XXVIII. Of Baptiſm and the Lords Supper.

segments.text: 1. BAptiſm and the Lords Supper are ordinances of poſitive, and ſoveraign inſtitution; appointed by the Lord Jeſus the only Law-giver, to be continued in his Church to the end of the world.
2, Theſe holy appointments are to be adminiſted by thoſe only, who are qualified and thereunto called according to the commiſſion of Chriſt.
